title: Family Emergency Offline Library
description: A practical, source-first Project NOMAD library emphasizing medicine, disaster guidance, repair, food, and broad reference coverage while staying below a 100 GiB content budget.
notes: Downloaded archives are not stored in this repository.
Kiwix snapshots are static and must not be treated as live alerts, evacuation orders, road closures, recalls, or weather reports.
The complete English Wikipedia mini edition provides breadth without images; the Best of Wikipedia maxi edition adds full-detail illustrated coverage for a smaller high-value subset.
Safety-critical procedures should be checked against the displayed original source. Local AI is optional and is not an authority.

resources.title: Wikipedia Medicine / WikiMed
resources.why: Illustrated medical encyclopedia for offline reference; use professional guidance for treatment decisions.

resources.title: MedlinePlus
resources.why: Consumer health information from the U.S. National Library of Medicine.

resources.title: NHS Medicines
resources.why: Compact medicine-use and safety reference from the UK National Health Service.

resources.title: CDC Travelers' Health
resources.why: CDC infectious-disease and travel-health reference; stored guidance is not a live outbreak notice.

resources.title: LibreTexts Medicine
resources.why: Detailed educational medical texts that complement concise consumer references.

resources.title: Libre Pathology
resources.why: Illustrated pathology reference; primarily educational rather than a self-diagnosis tool.

resources.title: Military Medicine
resources.why: Field and austere-medicine material kept as a secondary reference, not a substitute for current civilian clinical guidance.

resources.title: OpenZIM Medicine Collection
resources.why: Small additional medicine collection retained for breadth and redundancy.

resources.title: Ready.gov
resources.why: Official U.S. civilian disaster-preparedness guidance across common hazards.

resources.title: iFixit Repair Guides
resources.why: Illustrated repair procedures for electronics, appliances, vehicles, and household equipment.

resources.title: Home Improvement Stack Exchange
resources.why: Searchable troubleshooting for plumbing, electrical, building, and household repairs; verify hazardous work against codes and manuals.

resources.title: Motor Vehicle Maintenance & Repair Stack Exchange
resources.why: Offline vehicle troubleshooting and maintenance reference.

resources.title: Woodworking Stack Exchange
resources.why: Practical material, tool, joinery, and repair knowledge.

resources.title: Seasoned Advice / Cooking Stack Exchange
resources.why: Food preparation, preservation, substitution, and troubleshooting reference.

resources.title: FOSS Cooking
resources.why: Compact offline recipe collection useful for shelf-stable meal planning.

resources.title: Gardening & Landscaping Stack Exchange
resources.why: Supplemental gardening troubleshooting only. This is a Q&A archive, not a coherent gardening guide or plant encyclopedia; retain only if its 0.93 GB cost remains justified after the content audit.

resources.title: Gardenology
resources.why: Illustrated, searchable plant and garden encyclopedia with 44,083 articles. Use as a broad reference; current Utah State University Extension guides remain preferable for regional growing recommendations.

resources.title: Complete English Wikipedia (Compact)
resources.why: Whole-encyclopedia breadth within the storage budget; intentionally omits images and full detail.

resources.title: Best of Wikipedia (With Images)
resources.why: Full-detail illustrated coverage of roughly 50,000 high-value articles without the 119 GB cost of full illustrated English Wikipedia.

resources.title: Wikibooks (With Images)
resources.why: Full-detail illustrated textbooks and practical manuals; the image edition costs only about 1.1 GB more than the no-picture edition.

maps.install_method: Use NOMAD Maps to select the United States, Canada, and Mexico in one detailed extract.
maps.limitations: No satellite imagery, live closures, address search, or route calculation.

kolibri.status: Installed; the Khan import is partial because 370 upstream files were skipped by the importer.
